effects.effect: Whenever an ally uses a [ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) ability while you are within the ability's [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance), you can spend 1 clarity as a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to allow them to use the ability as if they were in your space.
